data.narrative:
New Limit is a Series C biotech company currently valued at $3.1B post-money, having raised $610M+. Valuation analysis triangulates across a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in Biotech & Health, including same-stage peers Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B) and Chai Discovery ($3.8B).

Two methods are applicable. Stage-Progression applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier from the $3.1B last post-money valuation, implying $5.3B at the next funding stage. Peer-Median anchors to the median valuation of three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables at $3.8B, with a range spanning $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $10.3B (Colossal, Series C). Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures.

The triangulated range supported by these two methods is $3.2B (low) to $6.1B (high), with a median of $4.5B. This range reflects tension between the current post-money valuation, conservative peer-median positioning, and the stage-progression uplift. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory (undisclosed), clinical or commercial inflection timing, and valuation dispersion within the peer set—particularly the 19x spread between Eikon and Colossal at adjacent stages.
